title: Teardown of an IKEA Koppla USB power supply.
summary: Big Clive takes apart an IKEA Koppla USB power supply to assess its safety, looking at isolation and transformer construction.
why: Cited as a teardown of a well-made, safe USB charger, and as evidence for why quality chargers matter.

quote.text: Big Clive also did a fairly comprehensive teardown of the IKEA charger and was pleasantly surprised with the design
